question.prompt: What is the slope of a line perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis?

solutions.explanation: The angle of inclination is \(90^\circ\), whose tangent is undefined, so the slope is undefined.
solutions.title: Inclination and tangent

solutions.explanation: A line perpendicular to the \(x\)-axis is vertical. Two distinct points on it have zero horizontal change and nonzero vertical change. Slope is vertical change divided by horizontal change, so it would require division by \(0\). Thus the slope is undefined, choice A.
solutions.title: Zero horizontal change
